# Vendored RandAR subset

This directory contains the minimal model and learning-rate utility files needed
by MoTAR, copied from:

- Upstream: https://github.com/ziqipang/RandAR
- Commit: `d374a721cfac8a42d8e11ee9a0c7ed967621aebf`
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE`

No upstream checkpoints, datasets, evaluation graphs, or generated artifacts are
vendored here.
